content: NIST SP 800-63B password guidance: original revision = minimum 8 chars, composition rules explicitly discouraged (8-4 rule rejected), screening against breached passwords recommended. Rev 4 (800-63B-4, latest) raises minimum to 15 when password is sole authenticator, 8 acceptable within MFA. D-25 (min length 8, no complexity) matches original-revision guidance and the FastAPI tutorial's simple approach; guide should cite length-over-composition rationale.
